text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high error rate during canary rollout of redwood-api v2.18. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-api-canary. Trigger: 5xx spike >10% over baseline. Link: https://ops.redwood.internal/incidents/2060012345

deploy-bot: rollout started by @Alex Chen at 2026-03-15T04:10:12Z. Canary pods: 4/4 -> 2/4 healthy. current image: redwood-api:v2.18-canary

Alex Chen: acked. I'm on it. first check logs + metrics, will try to pause canary if needed.

Priya Nair: seeing a ton of KMS Decrypt errors in runtime logs around 04:12UTC, looks like secrets can't be decrypted for the canary pods. sample:```
ERROR [2026-03-15T04:12:35Z] runtime: failed to load secret "model-credentials" - KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: Caller not authorized for key projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/llm/cryptoKeys/llm-2026
```

Marco Ruiz: I rotated the llm KMS key during maintenance at 04:11 to enforce new rotation policy. I thought the grant to redwood-service-sa was already in place but double-checking now.

Jen Park: if the canary can't read creds the runtime returns 503; that explains the 5xx spike. Immediate mitigation options: 1) kill canary flag so traffic shifts to stable 2) rollback canary image 3) set env override to use previous key id (fast but ugly)

Alex Chen: trying feature flag kill-switch now -> `ffctl set rollout.canary.enabled false --env prod`

deploy-bot: feature flag update acknowledged. Traffic rebalancing in progress. Canary weight -> 0%.

Sam (prod-support): CS reporting ~18 customers started seeing errors around 04:12 - top three flagged accounts: AcmeCorp, Healthlytics, Noteable. Many requests show 503 and `secret-decrypt-failure`.

Priya Nair: current graph: canary 5xx% 12.7% (was 0.3%). overall platform 5xx up to 3.8%. latency p95 up 120ms on average. approx 18 tenants affected, estimated 1.2k failed requests in the 10m window.

Marco Ruiz: quick check: I don't see the IAM binding for `redwood-service-sa` on the new key. I can add the CryptoKey decrypter role now.

Jen Park: to unblock immediately we can set env override on the runtime deployment to use old key id:```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/redwood-runtime REDWOOD_KMS_KEY_OVERRIDE=projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/llm/cryptoKeys/llm-2025-old
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/redwood-runtime
```
This will only affect pods that pick up the new env on restart. Might be faster than IAM change in some clouds.

Alex Chen: Marco, please add the IAM grant and confirm. I'm holding on rollback for now since flag kill reduced traffic but some stale canary pods still 503.

Marco Ruiz: IAM grant applied: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter -> serviceAccount:redwood-service-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Took effect at 04:20UTC.

Priya Nair: metrics: 5xx rate dropped to 1.1% platform-wide after grant + flag kill. Canary pods gradually recovered, canary 5xx -> 0.4% by 04:28UTC.

deploy-bot: rollout paused. canary replicas: 4 (2 were restarted). current image remains redwood-api:v2.18-canary but weight 0%.

Sam (prod-support): notifying affected customers: sent status updates to AcmeCorp and Healthlytics, CS ticket #78321 opened. cs-bot posted templates to CSE channel.

Jen Park: postmortem TODOs: - add release checklist item to verify KMS bindings as preflight - include KMS rotation in deploy notes - make feature-flag kill immediate for canary traffic in console - add automated guard that fails canary if secret decryption errors > X

Alex Chen: handing off on-call to Priya for follow-up and verification. Priya, can you own the post-incident verification and RCA? I'll update the incident doc and the changelog.

Priya Nair: taking on-call. I'll run a full sweep of recent key rotations and verify other service accounts. Also will schedule a hotfix to the rollout pipeline to include an IAM check.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated. Severity lowered to P3. Links: runbook https://ops.redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation, ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/78321

Alex Chen: thanks everyone. small follow-up: add a hold step to the KMS rotation playbook so we don't rotate live keys during active rollouts.

Priya Nair: noted. I'll add that and post the RCA draft in the #postmortems channel when ready.
